# Load data
```{r}
library(nirsextra)
library(rnirs)
d="C:/Users/guest/Documents/Martin/VitaSPEC/"
# d="/home/ecarnot/Documents/INRA/Projets/VitaSPEC/"
sp=sp2df(asd_read_dir(paste0(d,"20240325_Vitaspec_Pobe/")))
sp$ech=sub("-[^-]*$", "", rownames(sp))
ref=read.table(paste0(d,"Données_pour_NIRS_TEmeso.csv"), sep=";",header=TRUE, dec = ",")
ref$ech=paste0(ref$Identifiant,"-",ref$Code.arbre)
colnames(ref)[colnames(ref) == "TE1...MF."] = "Eau"
sp=merge(sp, ref,by="ech")
save(sp,file="vitaspec_fruits_frais_Mars2024")
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
source("vitaspec_preCV.R")
load("vitaspec_fruits_frais_Mars2024")

# Sur tous les spectres (sans moy)
#vitaspec_preCV(sp$x,sp$Eau,list_pre,15, titl="Teneur en eau. Tous points de mesure") 
# En moyennant les rép
spm=aggregate(sp,by=list(sp$ech), mean)
spm$x=as.matrix(aggregate(sp$x, list(sp$ech), mean)[,-1])
spm$ech=spm$Group.1; spm=spm[,-1]
vitaspec_preCV(spm$x,spm$Eau,list_pre,15, titl="Teneur en eau. Pts de mesures moy. par fruit") 

```


# Calibration with dryed mesocarp - Compare AGAP and DIADE spectrometer
```{r, warning=FALSE}
d="/home/ecarnot/Documents/INRA/Projets/VitaSPEC/"
sp=sp2df(asd_read_dir(paste0(d,"20240405_VitaSPEC_S_AGAP/")))
sp$ech=sub("-[^-]*$", "", rownames(sp))
ref=read.table(paste0(d,"Données_pour_NIRS_TEmeso.csv"), sep=";",header=TRUE, dec = ",")
ref$ech=paste0(ref$Identifiant,"-",ref$Code.arbre)
colnames(ref)[colnames(ref) == "TE1...MF."] = "Eau"
sp=merge(sp, ref,by="ech")
spm=aggregate(sp,by=list(sp$ech), mean)
spm$x=as.matrix(aggregate(sp$x, list(sp$ech), mean)[,-1])
spm$ech=spm$Group.1; spm=spm[,-1]
vitaspec_preCV(spm$x,spm$Eau,list_pre,10, titl="Teneur en eau. Pts de mesures moy. par fruit. Meso séché - AGAP") 

sp=sp2df(asd_read_dir(paste0(d,"20240405_VitaSPEC_S_DIADE/")))
sp$ech=sub("-[^-]*$", "", rownames(sp))
sp=merge(sp, ref,by="ech")
spm=aggregate(sp,by=list(sp$ech), mean)
spm$x=as.matrix(aggregate(sp$x, list(sp$ech), mean)[,-1])
spm$ech=spm$Group.1; spm=spm[,-1]
vitaspec_preCV(spm$x,spm$Eau,list_pre,10, titl="Teneur en eau. Pts de mesures moy. par fruit.  Meso séché - DIADE") 
```


Explore 2 years on fresh fruits
```{r, warning=FALSE}
d="C:/Users/guest/Documents/Martin/VitaSPEC/"
# d="/home/ecarnot/Documents/INRA/Projets/VitaSPEC/"
sp24=sp2df(asd_read_dir(paste0(d,"20240325_Vitaspec_Pobe/")))
sp24$annee=24
sp25=sp2df(asd_read_dir(paste0(d,"20250224_Vitaspec_Pobe/")))
sp25$annee=25
sp=rbind(sp24,sp25)
# Excude exocarp spectra
sp=sp[!grepl("FX",rownames(sp)),]

sp$ech=sub("-[^-]*$", "", rownames(sp))
# Average spectra
spm=aggregate(sp,by=list(sp$ech), mean)
spm$x=as.matrix(aggregate(sp$x, list(sp$ech), mean)[,-1])
spm$ech=spm$Group.1; spm=spm[,-1]

p=rbind(list('adj',''),list('snv',''))
spm$xp=pre(spm$x,p)
loess_fit <- apply(spm$xp, 1, function(s) loess(s ~ as.integer(colnames(spm$xp)), span = 0.05))
spm$xp2 <- I(t(sapply(loess_fit, function(t) t$fitted)))

col=rep("red",nrow(spm))
col[spm$annee==24]="black"
plotsp(spm$x,col=col)

fm <- pca(spm$xp2, ncomp = 10)
plotxy(fm$Tr[, c(1,2)], group = spm$annee)



#plot from VS
couleur <- brewer.pal(n = length(levels(as.factor(nirs.list.ade4$raw$info$Bloc))),
                      name = "Set1")
for (i in (1:length(pca.nirs))){
  s.class(dfxy = pca.nirs[[i]]$li,
          fac = as.factor(nirs.list.ade4[[i]]$info$Bloc), xax = 1, yax = 2,
          clabel = 0.7, col = couleur, sub = names(pca.nirs)[i], csub=2, possub="topleft")
}
```
